faq_heading: Homes near Erma Stephenson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Erma Stephenson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Erma Stephenson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Erma Stephenson Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Erma Stephenson Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 34 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,427,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Erma Stephenson Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Erma Stephenson Elementary the median was 29 days on the market, closing at 95.8% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 34 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Erma Stephenson Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Fraser Heights Secondary (0.3 km south-east), Dogwood Elementary (0.7 km south-west) and Fraser Wood Elementary (1.0 km south-east).

Erma Stephenson Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 10929 160 St. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Intensive French (6-7).
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Erma Stephenson Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Erma Stephenson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Erma Stephenson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Erma Stephenson Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 34 homes sold within 1 km of Erma Stephenson Elementary: 32 houses. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,427,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Erma Stephenson Elementary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Erma Stephenson Elementary in a straight line (10 elementary, 4 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Fraser Heights Secondary, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Ellendale Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Dogwood Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Pacific Academy (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Dogwood Elementary (0.7 km south-west), Fraser Wood Elementary (1.0 km south-east), Harold Bishop Elementary (1.2 km south-west), Holly Elementary (2.0 km west), William F. Davidson Elementary (2.2 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Dogwood Elementary, 0.7 km south-west of Erma Stephenson Elementary.
